evidence.exportsMap: Alphabetical exports map: a `./date-*` entry would sort between `./context-menu` (line 217) and `./dialog` (line 231); the map goes context-menu -> dialog with no gap. No ./date-field, ./date-input or ./date-segment subpath exists.
evidence.shared: see the shared evidence block: docs index has 37 components (no Date Field), bundled docs has no date page, CHANGELOG/release notes contain no date component.
evidence.nearMiss: Base UI 1.8.0 does ship segmented/field-style inputs — Input, Number Field (with scrub area), OTP Field — so a plain styled <input type="date"> or a native date input is the only in-library option for now. The repo's InputDateBase wraps RAC DateField/DateInput/DateSegment for the segmented UI.

consequence: No migration path in 1.8.0 for a segmented date input with locale-aware segments. Keep React Aria, or replace with a native <input type="date"> if the segmented UX is acceptable to lose (it is not, for this design system).
notableDifferences: React Aria's DateSegment exposes per-segment state and keyboard editing (increment/decrement per segment, literal separators, locale ordering) — Base UI has nothing comparable; its closest primitive (Number Field) has a single input plus increment/decrement buttons and a scrub area.
RAC DateField integrates with Form/validation and @internationalized/date values; Base UI's form integration (Form/Field) targets native inputs and its own components only.
